source_note: FEWS NET Uganda-Karamoja Region Livelihood Zones report: land preparation Jan-Mar, planting Mar-Jul, harvesting Aug-Dec for cereals in the agro-pastoral zone.
FEWS NET Uganda-Karamoja Region Livelihood Zones report: first-season green maize consumption normally starts early August, so maize is planted and harvested earlier in the season than sorghum.
